## Website Uptime Monitor with Instant Alerts

Know the moment your website goes down - before your customers tell you - without paying for uptime monitoring SaaS.

**Setup time:** 5 minutes  ·  **Level:** Beginner

**You'll need accounts/credentials for:** Schedule, HTTP Request, IF, Gmail

**Setup steps:**
1. Open the HTTP Request node and replace the URL with your website address.
2. Connect Gmail (or swap for Slack/Telegram) in the alert node and set your address.
3. Optionally change the schedule from 5 minutes to your preferred interval.
4. Activate the workflow. Test it by temporarily pointing the URL at a page that returns 404.

Free templates and updates: navkhan103.github.io

### How it runs

Starts from **Every 5 Minutes**.

1. A Schedule Trigger fires every 5 minutes.
2. An HTTP Request node loads your website and never throws, even on errors.
3. An IF node checks the status code: anything other than 200 means trouble.
4. A Gmail node fires an alert with the status code and time, only on failure - no noise.

### If something breaks

The read and AI nodes here **retry 3× automatically** (5s apart), which absorbs rate limits and brief timeouts.

Nodes that **send or write deliberately do not retry** — a send that reached the far end but lost its response would otherwise fire twice, so you'd get duplicate messages or duplicate rows.

To be told when one of those fails, build a workflow starting with an **Error Trigger** node that posts to Slack or email, then set it under **three-dot menu > Settings > Error Workflow**. Do it once and point every workflow at it.
